description: Unit tests for Azure Table Storage data management functionalities using Orleans framework, focusing on CRUD operations, conditional updates, and exception handling.

classes.name: AzureTableDataManagerTests
classes.description: Test suite for Azure Data Table Storage operations, including create, read, update, delete, and conditional operations.

methods.name: GenerateNewData
methods.description: Generates a new unit test data object with a unique row key.

methods.name: AzureTableDataManagerTests
methods.description: Constructor initializing test setup and configuration.
